_comment: How a session says it is the live rig's, not Sir's (T-0523, T-1201). Two marks. (1) The rig names every conversation it opens with `namespace` (testing/live/ground.py TEST_NAMESPACE) and the house hands the name on to Hermes as `house-<conversation id>` (aura-core/aura/integrations/voice/hermes.py), so a session id that contains it is a probe. (2) A deploy's own probes (scripts/smoke.sh, scripts/verify/golden-turn.mjs) talk through the real HUD socket as platform tui with a session id Hermes chose, so they cannot name the session; they say what they are on prompt.submit as `params.surface = {"name": probe_surface}`, which the adapter records per session (aura_adapter/surface.py) and hermes/plugins/jarvis-hud/habits.py (RIG_SESSION, PROBE_SURFACE) reads back. Either mark makes note_turn skip the turn: a probe said on three days is not a habit. The scripts run inside containers with no checkout, so each names the value as a constant and deploy/tests/test_probe_mark.py reads their text against this file. Not covered: a rig turn through the real console that does not rewrite its frame carries no mark; a probe whose adapter is down when note_turn asks is counted (fail open, as the phone's surface check does). Readers: testing/live/tests/test_rig.py, hermes/plugins/jarvis-hud/tests/test_habits.py, deploy/tests/test_probe_mark.py.
